query_text:
use catalog abch_certio_dwh_{{env}};

/*
fetch maximum batch ID to determine what's the most current batch
*/
with maxBatchId as (
  select
    max(batchId) maxBatchId
  from cfg_sch.cfg_error_log
  where reprocessedDatetime is null
)
select
  'ERROR_TABLE' as source
  , log.batchId
  , log.sourceTable as sourceTable
  , array_join(collect_set(log.errorDescription), ' | ') as listErrors
  , count(distinct log.sourceRowId) as countFailedRows

from cfg_sch.cfg_error_log log
inner join maxBatchId max
  on log.batchId = max.maxBatchId
where
  log.reprocessedDatetime is null
group by
  log.batchId
  , log.sourceTable

UNION ALL

select
  'AUDIT_TABLE' as source
  , aud.batchId
  , aud.sourceTableName as sourceTable
  , array_join(collect_set(aud.errorMessage), ' | ') as listErrors
  , NULL as countFailedRows

from cfg_sch.cfg_audit aud
inner join maxBatchId max
  on aud.batchId = max.maxBatchId
where
  aud.status = 'Failed'
group by
  aud.batchId
  , aud.sourceTableName
order by
  batchID
  , sourceTable
;
